mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_POST ( member_idx, category_idx, range_idx, title, content, view_count, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{memberIdx}, #{categoryIdx}, #{rangeIdx}, #{title}, #{content}, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, m.nick_name as author, m.profile_image_url as profileImageUrl, c.name as categoryName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_LIKE WHERE post_idx = p.idx AND comment_idx IS NULL) as likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_UNLIKE WHERE post_idx = p.idx AND comment_idx IS NULL) as unlikeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_COMMENT WHERE post_idx = p.idx) as commentCount, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LIKE WHERE post_idx = p.idx AND member_idx = #{memberIdx} AND comment_idx IS NULL ) THEN true ELSE false END as isLiked, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_UNLIKE WHERE post_idx = p.idx AND member_idx = #{memberIdx} AND comment_idx IS NULL ) THEN true ELSE false END as isUnliked FROM TB_POST p LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON p.member_idx = m.idx LEFT JOIN TB_CATEGORY c ON p.category_idx = c.idx WHERE p.idx = #{postIdx}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_POST SET category_idx = #{categoryIdx}, range_idx = #{rangeIdx}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE idx = #{idx} AND member_idx = #{memberIdx}
